groups.title: Chrono-based retry policy contract
groups.intent: Review the public migration from integer milliseconds to typed chrono durations.
evidence: The public header replaces integer delay inputs and outputs with std::chrono::milliseconds.
reviewerChecks: Confirm all callers can migrate without unit ambiguity.

titleEvidence.rationale: The public header hunk defines the chrono-based retry policy contract.

groups.title: Capped exponential backoff behavior
groups.intent: Review the exponential delay calculation and its 30-second ceiling as one behavioral decision.
evidence: The implementation doubles the base delay by attempt and caps the result at 30 seconds.
reviewerChecks: Check attempt boundaries, overflow protection, and cap semantics.

titleEvidence.rationale: The source hunk implements both exponential growth and the maximum delay.

groups.title: Backoff examples and boundary coverage
groups.intent: Review the updated baseline assertion with the new zero, growth, and cap cases.
evidence: The tests exercise attempts zero through three and attempts above the maximum-delay threshold.
reviewerChecks: Confirm each assertion would fail under the former linear-delay behavior.

titleEvidence.rationale: The cited test hunks contain the growth, cap, and migrated baseline assertions.

groups.title: Backoff test target integration
groups.intent: Verify that the new backoff test is compiled and executed by the existing CMake test setup.
evidence: CMake adds retry_policy_backoff_test.cpp to the retry_policy_tests executable.
reviewerChecks: Confirm the target structure supports every test source and registers the executable with the test runner.

titleEvidence.rationale: The CMake hunk is the integration point for the new backoff test source.
